tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for agreeing to participate. I'd like to ask you some questions about your experiences with gardening. First, do you have a garden or any plants that you take care of, if so, how often do you spend time gardening and if not, why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您同意参与。我想问您几个关于园艺经历的问题。首先，您是否有花园或任何自己照料的植物？如果有，您通常每周花多少时间在园艺上？如果没有，原因是为什么呢？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you. What kinds of plants or gardens have you seen or heard about that you found interesting or appealing? Describe them and talk about why you found them interesting or appealing.
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢。您见过或听说过哪些您觉得有趣或有吸引力的植物或花园类型？请描述它们，并谈谈您为什么觉得它们有趣或有吸引力。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting, what challenges do you think people face when trying to grow plants or maintain a garden?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。您认为人们在尝试种植植物或打理花园时会面临哪些挑战？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great, some people believe that gardening can have positive effects on personal mental health and well-being. Do you agree or disagree with this viewpoint, why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。有些人认为园艺对个人的心理健康和幸福感有积极影响。您同意还是不同意这个观点？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
